name: Don Baker Farm
tagline: Don Baker Farm & Orchard ~ striving to survive in a changing marketplace
description: Don Baker Farm grows Apples, Pears, and Cherries in Hudson, NY. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
